features.poe: optional IEEE 802.3af/at/bt Type 4 Class 8, 90 W per port, persistent PoE

management.mgmt-ports: 1x RJ45 console, OOB management as a combo pair (RJ45 at the mgmt stack and SFP in the top band share one interface), 2x USB 3.0 Type A

platform.cpu: Intel Denverton x86, 4C @ 2.1 GHz (8C @ 2.2 GHz option)

gaps.wanted: a top-level `profile:` naming the device class, so that `specified` has something to judge the attrs against - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml for the classes that exist, which unlocks `specified` and with it the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 2 bays (rear 2); `physical-context` on port groups rj45-1g, sfp28 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.console-symbol: photo - the IOIOI console mark is printed BELOW the console jack, near the panel lower lip and below the port-pair legend row (a chassis-front photograph, shot upside down). It was at baseline 35.6, inside the jack. The x is unchanged - the photograph is not orthographic enough to re-derive it
provenance.fans: datasheet (2+1 FIXED fans - not FRUs; three grilles seen on the rear photo)
provenance.layout: measured from a square-on product photo (the vendor's front product photograph), calibrated on two independent references - the 438.2mm chassis body and the 482.6mm rack width - which agree to 99.6 percent. Column pitch 13.99mm, extra 8.0mm between the four blocks, first column centre 8.46mm from the faceplate edge. Supersedes the earlier oblique-photo reading (order and grouping are reliable, mm positions are NOT calibrated; column pitch 14.5mm estimated from the front photo and from fitting 24 columns plus the uplink and management clusters into 438.2mm). Needs caliper verification or a square-on photo before the geometry can be trusted.
provenance.port-apertures: measured - the ganged cell is 12.7 x 11.0 on a 13.97 pitch, read off this device's own square-on photo and confirmed against the TE 2497310-1 2x6 magjack CAD; the twenty-four data jacks are common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 and the console is the bare std/rj45-ganged@2 (docs/rj45-family-design.md). The figure was carried as estimated until #125 sourced it
provenance.port-leds: photo - the two link and activity lamps moulded into each RJ45's own housing, one pair per port. They were twenty-four pairs of separate common/led-dot placements in a port-leds group until #125; they are now led-a and led-b of common/rj45-ganged-eth@1, which is what the housing actually carries. No vendor table gives their colours, so none is claimed
provenance.vent-islands: derived - a vent field is a perforation and the drawing said so, but the marks printed inside one were floating on air (L64). The vendor interrupts the perforation where it prints, so each of those marks now has a solid patch under it in the chassis colour, drawn over the vent the way ufispace/s9600-72xc paints its port bands over one. The patch is the printing's own footprint plus 0.4 mm, which is what the S9610-36D's front render measures: its slots stop 0.4 mm outside each lamp cluster and resume 0.4 mm past it. Where a vent is simply measured wider than the metal it reaches, this states the metal that the printing proves is there without re-measuring the field.
